items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: Because we have quite a few pioneers left... I've done more singing, Emma, she's done more singing than we did last year. But last year she didn't sing close or walk with me, but this year she did.

ctx.x: Wendell Eugene plays, uh, slide. Well, he played a couple of times in there, because I had hired him. When, uh, Jim couldn't make it, so I would get him, you know. So... Well, he said he couldn't keep it up, he said, because he was walking too much in the daytime to live in the mail. So, uh... After him, Jim came back. And he started playing again. And they put Poise in there with his band. That was with Emma. And who else did they have? I think she had a band in that, that one, at the early times.
Well, that was the time when you were playing there on weekends with what they call the All-Star Band. Do you remember?
